LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_HERMETIC_ORDER_DESCRIP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_HERMETIC_ORDER_DESCRIPTION]The Hermetic Order is a society of unorthodox scientists and alchemists. Their work focuses on science, great people, and resources.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_HERMETIC_ORDER_DISCOVE.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_HERMETIC_ORDER_DISCOVERY]A wandering mystic appears at your palace. His body is covered in writing of a kind that you have never seen before; the symbols even seem to shine of their own accord. He begins to lecture your courtiers about the hidden alchemical properties of matter: about how mercury can be induced to flow towards the sound of birdsong, how elemental sulfur can be rendered out of sacred texts, and about the hidden resonance of certain stones in moonlight. He asks you, "do you, too, seek to know the true nature of things?"

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_HERMETIC_ORDER_MEMBERS.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_HERMETIC_ORDER_MEMBERSHIP]Much that was hidden to you is now revealed. Matter is vibrant: metal and stone thrum with secret influences, starlight can be focused to illuminate essential fluids, and the earth itself pulses with energy and light. An entire wing of the palace is a bustle of alchemical activity, and you have learned to live with the occasional explosion.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_OWLS_OF_MINERVA_DESCRI.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_OWLS_OF_MINERVA_DESCRIPTION]The Owls of Minerva are a secret group of high-placed and wealthy individuals. They focus on government, trade, and espionage.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_OWLS_OF_MINERVA_DISCOV.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_OWLS_OF_MINERVA_DISCOVERY]A conversation with a new acquaintance turns to symbols: an eye in a pyramid, a two-headed owl, a serpent biting its own tail. "These are the signs by which we know each other," he says to you. Later, he invites you down through the tunnels below the city to a velvet-draped room filled with figures in cloaks and animal masks, and who you think you recognize as some of the richest and most important people in your empire - and beyond. "Join us," offers a woman in an elaborate moth mask, her voice dripping with wealth and privilege.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_OWLS_OF_MINERVA_MEMBER.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_OWLS_OF_MINERVA_MEMBERSHIP]The rites have been performed. You have recited the names of the founders and their lineages and memorized the signs of the Owls. It is astounding how many there were, all around you, all this time. Your finance minister hides a tattoo of a two-headed owl on his ankle; a silk merchant idly draws an eye on his open palm. Now you are of the Owls.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_SANGUINE_PACT_DESCRIPT.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_SANGUINE_PACT_DESCRIPTION]The Sanguine Pact share an unhealthy appetite for blood. They focus on building a strong military.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_SANGUINE_PACT_DISCOVER.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_SANGUINE_PACT_DISCOVERY]The girl shows up at the gates of the city, white-faced and mumbling about a dark stranger she met on the road, a rush of wind and wings, and the sweetest pain that she ever felt. Your doctors treat her, but she seems to be fading fast. As night falls, a foreign noblewoman (she seems like a noblewoman, at least, just as she seems foreign) appears at your gates. "The girl is with me," she says, her smile revealing astonishingly white – and prominent - teeth. "Perhaps you could invite me in?"

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_SANGUINE_PACT_MEMBERSH.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_SANGUINE_PACT_MEMBERSHIP]You have drunk of the red cup and felt new life course through your veins. The night seems alive with new possibilities, and appetites. Your palace stands shuttered and quiet during the day, and but after sunset new courtiers pace the halls, their feet making no sound as they go.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_VOIDSINGERS_DESCRIPTIO.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_VOIDSINGERS_DESCRIPTION]The Voidsingers are a nihilistic cult of dark elder gods. They focus on religion, relics, and (dis)loyalty.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_VOIDSINGERS_DISCOVERY.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_VOIDSINGERS_DISCOVERY]It started with a dream of the sea. The waves surged towards the shore but refused to break upon the sand, the water’s surface having been turned to something more like skin. A vast dark shape moved underneath, its form constantly growing new limbs and resorbing old ones. On the wind, there was a song that whispered to you its name, a set of syllables not designed for human tongues. The next day, in the market, you overhear a young urchin with a hollow stare mutter something in this same language.

LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_VOIDSINGERS_MEMBERSHIP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_SECRETSOCIETY_VOIDSINGERS_MEMBERSHIP]Our world is shallow - theirs is deep. You have opened your mind to the song of the void and accepted its truth. The Old Ones are sleeping, but we can hear their dreams. What seems to be madness is a higher truth. We wait and watch the sea and sing their praises.

LOC_TUTORIAL_CORPORATION_OPPORTUNITY_A.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_CORPORATION_OPPORTUNITY_A]Now that we hold a monopoly of the {1_ResourceIcon} {2_Resource} resource, we can upgrade that Industry into a Corporation. This allows us to create Products that can be spread to other Civilizations.

LOC_TUTORIAL_CORPORATION_OPPORTUNITY_B.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_CORPORATION_OPPORTUNITY_B]We now have the ability to form Corporations on top of Luxury resources in our territory. Corporations can be created once we control a monopoly of a Luxury. Once established, Corporations can then create Products that can be spread to other Civilizations.

LOC_TUTORIAL_DRAMATIC_AGES_FIRST_DARK_AG.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_DRAMATIC_AGES_FIRST_DARK_AGE]Your civilization has entered a Dark Age. Some of your cities have rebelled and joined the Free Cities – these will be hostile! As a consolation, you now have access to Dark Policies that you can use to try to turn things around.

LOC_TUTORIAL_DRAMATIC_AGES_FIRST_GOLDEN_.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_DRAMATIC_AGES_FIRST_GOLDEN_AGE]You have entered a Golden Age! You now have access to Golden Policies that you can use in the Wildcard slot in your government. Also, any excess Era Score from the last Age has been converted to increased Loyalty pressure – now is the time to use it!

LOC_TUTORIAL_FIRST_TIME_DRAMATIC_AGES.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_FIRST_TIME_DRAMATIC_AGES]With Dramatic Ages enabled, the stakes of each Age are much higher! Aside from the initial Age, each Age will be either Golden or Dark, depending on your civilization’s Era Score. You gain Era Score by completing Techs and Civics from the present Era or later. If you earn a Golden Age, any excess Era Score will turn into extra Loyalty pressure, which can be a significant factor if your neighbor has fallen into a Dark Age. In addition, you will have access to powerful Policy cards that you can use in the Wildcard slot of your government but watch out – entering a Dark Age means that some of your cities will rebel!

LOC_TUTORIAL_FIRST_TIME_MEGADISASTERS.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_FIRST_TIME_MEGADISASTERS]Our world has turned against us! With Apocalypse Mode enabled, droughts, storms, floods, and volcanic eruptions are more frequent and more dangerous.  Luckily, you can train a Soothsayer who might be able to turn these calamities onto your enemies. Keep an eye on the climate; with a final temperature increase, the world will enter the Apocalypse, and disasters will strike every turn!

LOC_TUTORIAL_FIRST_TIME_MONOPOLIES.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_FIRST_TIME_MONOPOLIES]Turn your battlefields into marketplaces! With Monopolies and Corporations Mode enabled, controlling and improving Luxury resources provides new benefits. Start first by establishing Industries around the resources in your territory. Reap the monetary benefits of holding a monopoly on a Luxury resource by owning an overwhelming majority of its production in the world. Once you have a monopoly, form powerful Corporations to spread your influence to other civilizations. World dominance isn’t always achieved by the sword!

LOC_TUTORIAL_FOREST_FIRES.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_FOREST_FIRES]Lightning or human error has sparked a forest fire! The flames will spread to any adjacent forest or jungle. While the smoke will cause us some trouble, the ash will provide good fertilizer. After the flames die down, of course.

LOC_TUTORIAL_INDUSTRY_INTRO.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_INDUSTRY_INTRO]If we improve a second {1_ResourceIcon} {2_Resource} resource we will control enough to create an Industry around it! Industries benefit the city in which they are built by providing substantial production discounts or additional yields.

LOC_TUTORIAL_INDUSTRY_OPPORTUNITY_A.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_INDUSTRY_OPPORTUNITY_A]Now that we have improved a second {1_ResourceIcon} {2_Resource} resource, we can create an Industry, if we order one of our Builders to construct one there.

LOC_TUTORIAL_INDUSTRY_OPPORTUNITY_B.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_INDUSTRY_OPPORTUNITY_B]Our newfound knowledge of Currency has given us a better means of exchange. We now have the ability to create Industries on top of improved Luxury resources. Industries can be created once we have improved more than one of the same Luxury in our territory.

LOC_TUTORIAL_METEOR_SHOWERS.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_METEOR_SHOWERS]Meteors have fallen from the sky! Let's see what they've brought with them.

LOC_TUTORIAL_SOLAR_FLARES.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_SOLAR_FLARES]The world is experiencing a solar flare, damaging all of our electrical equipment. Our power-generating buildings and improvements, and even our electricity-using units have been damaged!

LOC_TUTORIAL_SOOTHSAYERS.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_TUTORIAL_SOOTHSAYERS]Soothsayers are now available to us through Faith. Soothsayers may call disasters onto your enemies. Through competing with other civilizations, you can increase their power by sacrificing your combat units to volcanoes.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_AREA_DAMAGE_HEAL_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_AREA_DAMAGE_HEAL_HELP]Damage all adjacent enemies and heal all adjacent owned units by {1_DamageAmount}. Costs 1 Charge and ends turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_COMPLETE_DISTRICT_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_COMPLETE_DISTRICT_HELP]Use when located on a friendly District under construction. Hercules immediately completes construction of the District. Costs 2 Charges and ends turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_CREATE_RANDOM_RESOURCE_H.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_CREATE_RANDOM_RESOURCE_HELP]Use when located on an unowned, empty plot. Maui creates a random Bonus or Luxury Resource on the plot. Costs 1 Charge and ends turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_DESTROY_DEVELOPMENT_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_DESTROY_DEVELOPMENT_HELP]Use when located on an enemy District. Hercules destroys all buildings present and pillages the District. Costs 1 Charge and ends turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_DISTRICT_AT.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_DISTRICT_AT_WAR]Cannot target a district in a city at war with us.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_NOT_IN_SUZE.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_NOT_IN_SUZERAIN_TERRITORY]Must be inside the territory of a City-State you are Suzerain of.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_NOT_ON_INCO.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_NOT_ON_INCOMPLETE_DISTRICT]Must be used on a district under construction.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_NOT_ON_LUXU.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_NOT_ON_LUXURY_OR_BONUS_RESOURCE]Must be used on a Luxury or Bonus Resource.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_NO_LEVY_AVA.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_NO_LEVY_AVAILABLE]This City-State has no units available to levy.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_ON_ALLIED_P.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_ON_ALLIED_PLOT]Cannot be used on a plot owned by an allied civilization.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_ON_CITY_CEN.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_ON_CITY_CENTER]Cannot be used on a City Center.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_ON_IMPROVEM.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_ON_IMPROVEMENT]Cannot be used on an improved tile.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_ON_RESOURCE.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_ON_RESOURCE]Cannot be used on an existing resource.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_OWNED_PLOT.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_OWNED_PLOT]Cannot be used on an owned plot.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_USED_FEATUR.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FAILURE_HERO_USED_FEATURE]This ability has already been used on this {1_FeatureName}.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FORCE_LEVY_MILITARY_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_FORCE_LEVY_MILITARY_HELP]Use when within the territory of a City-State you are Suzerain of. Himiko immediately levies its military at no cost. Costs 1 Charge and ends turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_GRANT_ENVOY_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_GRANT_ENVOY_HELP]Target any adjacent City-State. Himiko immediately places 1 free [ICON_Envoy] Envoy in the City-State. If you are already the Suzerain there, Himiko also earns {1_FaithChange} [ICON_FAITH] Faith. Costs 1 Charge and ends turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_KILL_WEAKER_UNIT_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_KILL_WEAKER_UNIT_HELP]Target an adjacent enemy unit with [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength less than Beowulf's. Beowulf immediately destroys the target. Costs 1 Charge, 1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_NAVAL_GOLD_RAID_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_NAVAL_GOLD_RAID_HELP]Target any adjacent enemy naval unit or Barbarian Camp. The target is either cleared or damaged by 50%, and Sinbad immediately earns {1_GoldReward} [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Costs 1 Charge and ends turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_RESOURCE_INSPIRE_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_RESOURCE_INSPIRE_HELP]Use when located on a Bonus or Luxury Resource. Anansi consumes the resource and generates {1_ScienceReward} [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and {2_CultureReward} [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. Any improvement present is destroyed. Costs 1 Charge and ends turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_RESTORE_UNIT_MOVES_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_RESTORE_UNIT_MOVES_HELP]Target any adjacent friendly unit that has moved or attacked this turn. Hippolyta immediately restores the unit's moves and attacks. Usable once per turn.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_SPREAD_DISSENT_FAILURE_R.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_SPREAD_DISSENT_FAILURE_REQUIRES_ENEMY_CITY]Must be adjacent to an enemy City Center

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_SPY_SUMMON_ZOMBIES_DESCR.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_SPY_SUMMON_ZOMBIES_DESCRIPTION]Upon completion, has a chance to spawn a Zombie for each tile worked by this city.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_TRANSFORM_UNIT_HELP.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNITCOMMAND_TRANSFORM_UNIT_HELP]Target an adjacent land military unit you control. Arthur transforms the unit into a Questing Knight: a unique Heavy Cavalry unit with increased [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and {1_LifespanVal} [ICON_Lifespan] Lifespan. Costs 1 Charge, 1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement.

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_TREAT_WITH_CLAN_BRIBE_HE.text: 花费{1_GoldAmount}点 [ICON_Gold] 金币，让此氏族在{2_Turns}回合内无法侵扰您的城市。此氏族将获得{3_ProgressAmount}点城邦转变点数。

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_TREAT_WITH_CLAN_DISPERSE.text: 摧毁哨站并获得{1_XPAmount}点经验值。

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_TREAT_WITH_CLAN_HIRE_HEL.text: 花费{1_GoldAmount}点 [ICON_Gold] 金币从此氏族雇佣一名{4_UnitName}单位。此单位将在本回合出现在城市{5_CityName}附近。此氏族将获得{2_ProgressAmount}点城邦转变点数。每{3_Turns}回合即可对氏族进行雇佣。

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_TREAT_WITH_CLAN_INCITE_H.text: 花费{1_GoldAmount}点 [ICON_Gold] 金币来鼓动此氏族对{4_CivName}发起侵扰。此氏族将损失{2_ProgressAmount}点城邦转变点数。每{3_Turns}回合即可对氏族进行煽动。
花费[ICON_Gold] 金币来鼓动此氏族对附近的其他文明或城邦发起侵扰。此氏族将损失{1_ProgressAmount}点城邦转变点数。每{2_Turns}回合即可对氏族进行煽动。

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_TREAT_WITH_CLAN_RAID_HEL.text: 获得{1_GoldAmount}点 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。哨站将保持完好无损，此氏族将损失{2_ProgressAmount}点城邦转变点数。每{3_Turns}回合即可对氏族进行扫荡。

LOC_UNITCOMMAND_TREAT_WITH_CLAN_RANSOM_H.text: 花费{1_GoldAmount}点 [ICON_Gold] 金币来赎回被俘的{2_UnitName}。此氏族将损失城邦转变点数。

LOC_UNIT_CULTIST_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_CULTIST_DESCRIPTION]Support unit unique to the Voidsingers. Once it dies or loses all charges, its devoted sacrifice awards the player a [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relic of the Void. Can move into foreign lands when not at war, and use a charge to Recruit Followers in an adjacent foreign city, causing it to lose 10 Loyalty.

LOC_UNIT_ESTABLISH_INDUSTRY_INSUFFICIENT.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_ESTABLISH_INDUSTRY_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES]Must control {1_NumResources} or more of the same Luxury resource.

LOC_UNIT_FOUND_CORPORATION_INSUFFICIENT_.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_FOUND_CORPORATION_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES]Must control at least 75% of the same Luxury resources in the world.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_ANANSI_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_ANANSI_DESCRIPTION]Demigod and traveler of African folklore, renowned for his wit and trickery.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_ARTHUR_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_ARTHUR_DESCRIPTION]King and founder of the Knights of the Round Table, renowned for his virtue and chivalry.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_BEOWULF_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_BEOWULF_DESCRIPTION]Mighty warrior of the far North, renowned for his strength and bravery in single combat.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_HERCULES_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_HERCULES_DESCRIPTION]Demigod of superhuman strength, renowned for his famous Labors.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_HIMIKO_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_HIMIKO_DESCRIPTION]Shaman-Queen of ancient Japan, renowned for her wisdom and mystical power.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_HIPPOLYTA_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_HIPPOLYTA_DESCRIPTION]Warrior Queen of the Amazons, renowned for her leadership and martial skill.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_HUNAHPU_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_HUNAHPU_DESCRIPTION]Legendary athletes and heroes of the Maya, renowned for their power over death and the Underworld.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_MAUI_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_MAUI_DESCRIPTION]Demigod and hero of Polynesian myth, renowned for his feats and gifts to humanity.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_MULAN_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_MULAN_DESCRIPTION]Devoted and skilled warrior, renowned for her devotion and loyalty.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_OYA_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_OYA_DESCRIPTION]Orisha of winds, storms, and lightning, renowned for her extreme power.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_SINBAD_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_SINBAD_DESCRIPTION][COLOR_LIGHTBLUE]Naval Hero.[ENDCOLOR] Adventurer and fortune-hunter, renowned for his strange and marvelous travels.

LOC_UNIT_HERO_WUKONG_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_HERO_WUKONG_DESCRIPTION]The Monkey King, hero of ancient China, renowned for his cunning and immortality.

LOC_UNIT_MODE_ZOMBIE_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_MODE_ZOMBIE_DESCRIPTION]A hostile melee unit that has a chance to appear on the map at a location where a unit has died. Its Melee Strength increases with each Zombie that has been eliminated, globally. If a Zombie destroys another unit, a new Zombie unit spawns in that tile the next turn. If a Zombie reduces a city's population, a new Zombie unit will spawn immediately next to the city. Zombies target the closest nearby unit, city, or defensible district.

LOC_UNIT_QUESTING_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_QUESTING_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION]Heavy Cavalry. One of Arthur's chosen Knights and strengthened by his charge.

LOC_UNIT_VAMPIRE_DESCRIPTION.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_UNIT_VAMPIRE_DESCRIPTION]Combat unit unique to the Sanguine Pact. Has base [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength equal to the strongest unit your cities have produced. Gains permanent [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when units die in adjacent tiles.  Strength from Barbarian deaths is capped at +10. When killed, retreats with 1 HP to the [ICON_Capital] Capital or nearest Vampire Castle. Heals an additional 50 HP from pillaging enemy tiles, but receives reduced passive healing.

LOC_WORLD_CONGRESS_APPEASE_SUMMARY.text: [COLOR_RED]TRANSLATION MISSING[ENDCOLOR][LOC_WORLD_CONGRESS_APPEASE_SUMMARY]"The gods have warned us: the end of the world is coming.  They will grant their followers boons, but we must first prove our fervor.  Only the most zealous will be rewarded."
